questions.q: How do I earn with my Pintopay card?
questions.a: Every transaction on your card generates cashback. Plus, you earn commissions from your partner network (Free: 3 levels, PRO: 9 levels, PRO+: 20 levels deep). The more you and your team use cards, the more passive income flows to you.
Virtual cards: $10,000/month. Physical cards: $25,000/month. Platinum cards: $100,000/month. Limits increase with your partner level and PRO status.

questions.q: How does the referral network work?
questions.a: You earn commissions from partners across different depths. Free plan: 3 levels (L1=30%, L2=10%, L3=3%). PRO: 9 levels (L4-L9 = 1% each). PRO+: 20 levels (L10-L20 = 0.6% each). Each level provides passive commissions from network growth.

questions.q: How do levels and XP work?
questions.a: Complete tasks and hit milestones to earn XP. Each level unlocks new features, higher card limits, and exclusive bonuses. Level 100 is the ultimate achievement with maximum rewards.

questions.q: Can I withdraw my earnings anytime?
questions.a: Yes! Earnings are instantly available. Withdraw to your Pintopay card, crypto wallet, or bank account with minimal fees. No holding periods.
A 100-stage marketing mastery program teaching you to build a $1/minute income using AI automation, viral growth tactics, and P2P strategies. Free stages 1-20, PRO unlocks all 100.

Absolutely. We use bank-grade encryption, your funds are protected by blockchain systems, and we never share your data. All transactions are monitored for fraud protection.

Income depends on your activity. The AI Studio amplifies your efforts, but getting started is still up to you.

questions.q: What happens if I stop paying PRO?
questions.a: You can't stop paying because you only pay ONCE. It's a lifetime license. You own your status forever.

questions.q: How to add Partner Center to my Home Screen?
questions.a:
**For iPhone (iOS):**
1. Open the **Partner Center** in *Safari*.
2. Tap the **Share** icon (the square with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of the screen.
3. Scroll down and select **Add to Home Screen**.
4. Tap **Add in the top-right corner.**
*(This creates an app icon on your home screen for instant access.)*

**For Android:**
1. Open the **Partner Center** in *Chrome*.
2. Tap the **three dots** menu icon in the top-right corner.
3. Select **Install App** or **Add to Home Screen**.
4. Confirm by tapping **Add**.
*(Now you can launch the app directly without opening Telegram.)*
